//: Copy to .claude/settings.json, or run `tower init --hooks` to write it for you. SessionStart registers this session on the board; UserPromptSubmit nudges you when a teammate delegated work; PreToolUse BLOCKS an edit that hard-conflicts; PostToolUse keeps presence and your claims alive while you work; SessionEnd releases your claims. All are silent on the happy path, so a whole session of checking costs zero context. Requires `npm run build` first. For a remote team Tower, set TOWER_URL / TOWER_TOKEN.
